specific_objectives: 17.1.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand the construction and requirements of typical aircraft fuel system and its components.

intro_questions: What is the primary function of an aircraft fuel tank?
Name two common locations for fuel tanks in an airframe.
Why is the construction of fuel tanks critical for aircraft safety?

summary_questions: Explain the difference between an integral tank and a bladder tank.
Describe the function of the fuel tank sump in the airframe arrangement.
How does the vapor vent system prevent tank over-pressurization?
